desc: The Python Combat Elite features modern stainless steel alloys and a re-designed rear sight. Thirty percent more steel beneath the rear adjustable target sight gives you a stronger revolver and more robust shooting experience. A recessed target crown, front night sight, G10 grip with the iconic Colt medallion, and unfluted cylinder make this a gun you'll want to shoot AND show off. The Python is chambered in .357 Magnum and also accommodates .38 Special cartridges.
